fees.source: https://www.stowohio.gov/338/Stow-Silver-Springs-Campground ('2026 Camping Season ... Site Fees: $22.00 per night') + FAQs ('$22 a site per night'), read 2026-10-20

season.source: https://www.stowohio.gov/338/Stow-Silver-Springs-Campground ('2026 Camping Season: April 10 - October 31, 2026 (weather permitting)') + Camping Rules ('Camping season is April 10th - October 31st'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: City of Stow. Online (Campspot) or at Stow City Hall; reservations recommended. Booking for the season opened February 10, 2026. One site per adult registrant. Cancel or change up to 24 hours before arrival (4 pm) for a refund less $5. At most 15 nights in any 30 days. Check-in 4-10 pm, check-out 3 pm.

booking.source: https://www.stowohio.gov/338/Stow-Silver-Springs-Campground (booking, refund policy) + Camping Rules ('no more than fifteen (15) days within a thirty (30) day period', check-in/out), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.stowohio.gov/DocumentCenter/View/4453 (FAQs: 'We have 20 and 30 amp hook-ups'; no permanent water hookups) + the campground page ('no permanent hookups available' for water), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 27 campsites, some open and some shaded; no vehicle over 35 ft.

sites.source: https://www.stowohio.gov/338/Stow-Silver-Springs-Campground ('The facility has 27 campsites') + Camping Rules ('no vehicle may be more than 35 feet in length') + FAQs ('The maximum legal limit is 35-feet'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: No permanent restrooms with running water in the campground: portable restrooms on site, and flush restrooms with sinks at the park's ball fields, open 6 am - 10 pm in season. Water spigots around the campground; trailer dump station.

facilities.source: https://www.stowohio.gov/338/Stow-Silver-Springs-Campground ('several water spigots', 'A trailer dump station is available', 'portable restrooms are on-site. Flush restrooms are also accessible at our ball field area') + FAQs, read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $22/night. Added season Apr 10 - Oct 31, Campspot/City Hall booking with 15-in-30 limit and $5 cancellation, 20/30-amp electric with no water or sewer, 27 sites to 35 ft, spigots + dump + portable/ball-field restrooms.
